article.headline: Heady's 20 lead Bethune-Cookman over Grambling 76-71
article.description: — Jakobi Heady scored 20 points as Bethune-Cookman beat Grambling 76-71 on Thursday night.
article.story: GRAMBLING, La. -- — Jakobi Heady scored 20 points as Bethune-Cookman beat Grambling 76-71 on Thursday night. Heady also contributed six rebounds and four steals for the Wildcats (16-13, 13-3 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Daniel Rouzan scored 15 points and added six rebounds. Arterio Morris went 7 of 12 from the field to finish with 15 points. Derrius Ward led the Tigers (12-16, 6-9) in scoring, finishing with 24 points. Roderick Coffee III added 18 points, six assists and four steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
